输入向下越过阈值时输出一次 1，其余时间为 0。: Output 1 once when the input crosses the threshold downwards, and 0 otherwise.
向上越过阈值后，输出 1 并保持指定脉冲时长。: Output 1 for the configured pulse duration after an upward threshold crossing.
向上越过阈值时触发一次，冷却期间等待下一次有效触发。: Trigger once at an upward threshold crossing, then wait out the cooldown before another trigger.
输入连续达到阈值并保持指定时长后输出 1，条件结束时复位。: Output 1 after the input meets the threshold for the configured duration, and reset when the condition ends.
按频率生成节奏：偏移＋振幅×正弦。可添加一个输入调节振幅。: Generate a rhythm at the chosen frequency: offset + amplitude × sine. Add an optional input to modulate amplitude.
输入越过阈值后渐入到 1，回落后按相同时长渐出到 0。: Fade to 1 when the input reaches the threshold, then fade to 0 over the same duration when it falls back.
每个输出最多配置 {0} 条连接。: Each output supports at most {0} bindings.
方案应包含完整的输入映射、计算信号和输出配置。: A plan must contain input mappings, computed signals and output configurations.
按每条输出连接选择的来源与计算生成目标。: Generate each target from the source and processing selected for its output binding.
基础效果使用郊狼 3.0 的帧格式，选择对应设备后可用。播放方式由波形连接的发送: Basic effects use the Coyote 3.0 frame format and become available when that device is selected. The waveform binding's send mode determines playback.
方案一起保存输入映射、计算、轴配置及输出连接。载入时先检查目标地址和设备，再启用: A plan saves input mappings, calculations, axis profiles and output bindings together. After loading, review target addresses and devices before enabling outputs.
应用后替换当前计算、映射、轴配置和输出，输入及输出启用状态关闭。设备地址保留在草: Applying replaces the current calculations, mappings, axis profiles and outputs, with input and output activation turned off. Review the imported device addresses in the draft.
录制已达到文件大小上限: Recording reached its file size limit
使用 DG-LAB 4 APP 扫码配对。: Scan the code with the DG-LAB 4 app to pair.
映射结果达到 0.5 时按当前相位持续播放，停止或失效时清理任务。: When the mapped value reaches 0.5, continue playback at its current phase. Stop or invalid input clears the task.
映射结果达到 0.5 时触发一次波形任务，任务按持续时间结束。: Reaching a mapped value of 0.5 triggers one waveform task, ending after its configured duration.
通过 DG-LAB 4 APP 控制已配对的设备，强度和波形可以分别选择信号来源: Control paired devices through the DG-LAB 4 app, with separate signal sources for intensity and waveforms.
每条连接将参数名、转换后数值和时间组成 JSON，通过 HTTP POST 发送: Each binding sends its parameter name, converted value and timestamp as JSON using HTTP POST.
每条连接将参数名、转换后数值和时间组成 JSON，通过 WebSocket 长连: Each binding sends its parameter name, converted value and timestamp as JSON over a persistent WebSocket connection.
主题前缀和每条连接的发布主题组成目标主题，数值以 JSON 发送给 MQTT 服: The topic prefix and each binding's publish topic form the destination topic. Values are sent as JSON to the MQTT service.
将转换结果作为 MIDI CC 控制值发送到指定端口，用于调节软件参数或兼容设备: Send converted MIDI CC values to the selected port to adjust software controls or compatible devices.
此状态影响动作轴映射；独立输出连接按各自来源和有效状态更新。: This state affects motion axis mappings. Independent output bindings update according to their own sources and validity.
动作轴映射等待计算输入: Motion axis mappings await calculation inputs
动作轴映射门控关闭: Motion axis mapping gates are closed
动作轴映射门控关闭；独立输出连接按各自来源和有效状态更新。: Motion axis mapping gates are closed. Independent output bindings update according to their own sources and validity.
独立输出连接按各自来源和有效状态更新。: Independent output bindings update according to their own sources and validity.
强度跟随输入时自动续接短任务；持续播放的波形按 100 ms 整帧续接。: Intensity follows the input through automatically renewed short tasks. Continuous waveforms renew in complete 100 ms frames.
使用 L0、R0 等轴名可生成对应的多轴文件名，也可填写自定义轨道名称。: Use axis names such as L0 and R0 for corresponding multi-axis file names, or enter a custom track name.
载入脚本播放器后，此轨道的位置通过脚本 L0 信号提供；在输出连接中选择目标轴。: After loading into the script player, this track provides position through the script L0 signal. Choose its target axis in an output binding.
把信号录制为可播放的 Funscript 轨道，或保存为 JSON Lines、: Record signals as playable Funscript tracks, or save signal data as JSON Lines or CSV.
每条连接录制为独立轨道。将映射结果限制在 0–1，再转换为 Funscript: Each binding records a separate track. Mapped values are clamped to 0–1, then converted to Funscript positions from 0 to 100, with action times in milliseconds.
输入失效时结束当前片段，恢复后录制下一片段；每个文件从 0 ms 开始，并显示其: Invalid input ends the current clip; recording resumes in a new clip when input returns. Each file starts at 0 ms and shows its starting offset in the original recording.
完成的片段可下载或载入脚本播放器。载入信号回放后使用路径 {0}。: Download completed clips or load them into the script player. After loading a signal replay, use the path {0}.
信号数据保留原始值、转换值、有效状态和时间，供分析与信号流程回放。: Signal data retains raw and converted values, validity and timestamps for analysis and replay in a signal flow.
Funscript 回放以 0–1 提供位置，使用“录制回放”，路径填写 {0}: Funscript replay provides positions from 0 to 1. Choose Recording replay and enter {0}.
RightXYZ 与 ForwardXYZ 表示目标 X、Z 轴在 Avatar: RightXYZ and ForwardXYZ describe the target X/Z axes in the Avatar-root frame, retaining direction, length per local unit and shear. AvatarScale gives world metres per root-local unit.
方向分量与 AvatarScale 可作为 OSC 参数绑定，或加入计算信号进行: Bind the direction components and AvatarScale as OSC parameters, or combine them in computed signals.
“坐标有效”表示同一来源的完整 12 字段通过范围、轴向量与更新检查。三点渲染采: Valid coordinates means the complete 12-field update from one source passes range, basis-vector and activity checks. Three render samples provide position and the target X/Z plane; verify accuracy against known positions and directions.
Frame 是由 _Time×60 生成的 16 位循环编码时钟。Sensa 用: Frame is a 16-bit wrapping encoder clock generated from _Time×60. Sensa checks encoder activity and stops using the position when a frozen clock times out.
Valid=1 提交包含位置、RightXYZ、ForwardXYZ 和 Ava: Valid=1 commits a complete 12-field update containing position, RightXYZ, ForwardXYZ and AvatarScale; Valid=0 immediately invalidates the position. Recovery requires all parameters and a fresh Frame.
RightXYZ 与 ForwardXYZ 表示目标 X、Z 轴在 Avatar: RightXYZ and ForwardXYZ describe the target X/Z axes in the Avatar-root frame, preserving direction, length per local unit and shear. Each component ranges from −8 to 8 and can be a direct OSC input or part of a computed signal.
AvatarScale 表示每个 Avatar 根局部单位对应的世界米数，范围为: AvatarScale gives world metres per Avatar-root local unit, greater than 0 and at most 8. Multiply local displacement by the scale from the same packet to convert to metres along the root axes.
X/Y/Z 是 Avatar 根局部坐标，分别表示相对 Avatar 的左右、上: X/Y/Z are Avatar-root local coordinates for side-to-side, vertical and front-to-back position. The bridge sends a complete update in Frame, X, Y, Z, RightX, RightY, RightZ, ForwardX, ForwardY, ForwardZ, AvatarScale, Valid order.
选择定位测量的方向或缩放指标，可用于轴映射、输出绑定与计算信号，并遵循完整包有效: Use direction or scale metrics from Tracking measurement in axis mappings, output bindings and computed signals, with complete-packet validity checks. Browse the raw OSC parameters for readings and definitions.
保持目标有效，分别在期望的低值和高值状态下采集 0% 与 100%，再生成映射草: Keep the target valid, capture 0% and 100% at the intended low and high values, then create a mapping draft.
填写测量对象的整组路径，例如 Sensa/SPS/Root/**。可读取位置、C: Enter the measurement group path, such as Sensa/SPS/Root/**. Read position, Contact velocity, or Shader direction and scale; calculations follow the tracking method’s validity checks.
RightXYZ 与 ForwardXYZ 表示目标 X、Z 轴在 Avatar: RightXYZ and ForwardXYZ describe the target X/Z axes in the Avatar-root frame, preserving direction, length per local unit and shear. Each component ranges from −8 to 8. Select the corresponding Tracking measurement metric to retain complete-packet validity checks in outputs and calculations.
AvatarScale 表示每个 Avatar 根局部单位对应的世界米数，范围为: AvatarScale gives world metres per Avatar-root local unit, greater than 0 and at most 8. Read it through Tracking measurement and multiply local displacement from the same packet by it to convert to metres along the root axes.
先调整当前页的设置，点击“应用输入方式”后开始使用这类输入。: Adjust the settings here, then select Apply input mode to use this source.
在 Unity 中安装定位组件后，这里会显示测量对象。启用实验空间输入并保存，即: After installing a tracking component in Unity, its targets appear here. Enable experimental spatial input and save to use valid measurements for motion.
来源持续发送时，可设置多久未收到数据就暂停；来源只在数值变化时发送时，使用 0。: For continuously updating sources, set how long to wait before pausing. Use 0 for sources that send only when their values change.
点击播放器空白处后可使用快捷键；编辑输入框或滑块时，键盘用于当前控件。: Click an empty area of the player to use shortcuts. While editing a field or slider, keys control that focused element.
这组参数用于检查数据传输。位置映射请在根点面板选择测量对象。: Use these parameters to inspect data delivery. Select a measured target in the root panel to map its position.
其他输出连接继续使用各自的有效输入。: Other output connections continue using their own valid inputs.
动作轴正在等待触发条件；其他输出连接继续使用各自的有效输入。: Motion axes are waiting for their trigger condition. Other output connections continue using their own valid inputs.
触发条件尚未满足，动作已暂停。: Motion is paused while its trigger condition is unmet.
急停保持中。解除急停后，准备好即可重新启用输入。: Emergency stop is active. Clear it, then enable input when ready.
连接已断开。恢复连接后，请重新执行需要的操作。: The connection was lost. Once reconnected, repeat the action you need.
把 Sensa 计算出的 L0 主轴位置保存为 funscript，之后可在脚本: Save the L0 position calculated by Sensa as a funscript, ready to replay in the script player.
输入有效期填 0 时沿用 OSC 接收设置；也可填写毫秒数，让长时间未更新的输入: Set input validity to 0 to use the OSC receiver setting, or enter milliseconds to pause calculations when an input becomes stale. Tracking inputs also follow the validity conditions of their tracking method.
为计算取一个名称，再选择运算和输入。保存后，这个结果就能用于输出连接、轴映射或下: Name the calculation, choose an operation and add its inputs. Once saved, use its result in an output connection, axis mapping or another calculation.
选择方向或缩放指标，可将它转换为动作或用于计算。下方参数入口显示每项读数、含义和: Select a direction or scale measurement to map it to motion or use it in a calculation. The parameter link below shows each reading, meaning and unit.
RightXYZ 描述目标的 X 轴，ForwardXYZ 描述目标的 Z 轴；: RightXYZ describes the target X axis and ForwardXYZ its Z axis. Together they define the target plane and retain axis length and shear. AvatarScale converts Avatar-root local lengths to metres.
Sensa 将输入信号转换成设备动作、应用参数或录制文件。从下面选择一件想做的事: Sensa turns input signals into device motion, application parameters or recordings. Choose a task below, finish its setup, then enable input on the Control page.
Shader 将根点的位置、方向和 Avatar 缩放写入黑白图块。按捕获指南设: The Shader writes root position, direction and Avatar scale into a black-and-white tile. Follow the capture guide to set up Unity and a desktop capture area; the bridge sends the measurements to Sensa.
为设备保存行程、方向和速度设置，同一套配置可供多个 TCode 输出使用。: Save travel, direction and speed settings for a device. Several TCode outputs can share the same profile.
从画面读取位置和方向: Read position and direction from a picture
保存常用的轴范围与运动设置，通过日志了解连接、输入和输出的运行状态。: Save reusable axis ranges and motion settings. Use logs to follow connections, inputs and outputs.
在 OSC 页选择来源和预设，将接触深度、距离或速度映射到输出。参数详情提供含义: Choose a source and preset on the OSC page to map contact depth, distance or speed to an output. Parameter details explain meanings, ranges and official references.
在 Unity 中安装 SPS 四点定位或 Contact 直接定位组件，再选择: Install SPS four-anchor or Contact direct tracking in Unity and select a Socket or Plug. The root panel shows its position; Contact tracking also provides relative velocity.
手动调节、接收 OSC，或播放脚本。组合方式可以同时使用多个来源。: Adjust values manually, receive OSC or play a script. Combined mode lets several sources work together.
把多个参数做加权平均、范围转换或平滑处理。保存为一个计算信号后，可同时提供给多个: Average several parameters, convert their range or smooth their changes. Save the result as a computed signal and use it in several outputs.
按级别、分类或轴筛选消息，快速找到连接和数值变化的原因。: Filter messages by level, category or axis to understand connection events and value changes.
查看 OSC 实时数据，为需要的参数设置映射，或把定位结果转换为动作。: Inspect live OSC data, map the parameters you need or turn tracking measurements into motion.
组合多个来源，设置计算，再将结果发送到设备、应用或录制文件。: Combine sources, choose a calculation and send the result to devices, applications or recording files.
调好设备，查看运行情况: Set up and inspect your devices
输入起点对应输出起点，输入终点对应输出终点。中间的数值按所选曲线转换。: The input start maps to the output start, and the input end maps to the output end. Values in between follow the selected curve.
连接输出后，用滑块选择位置并发送一次。确认方向和行程后，可以连续发送或播放 fu: Connect an output, choose a position with the sliders and send it once. After checking direction and travel, use live updates or play a funscript.
选择输入方式，连接输出，再启用输入。运行中的数值和连接状态会持续显示。: Choose an input, connect an output and enable input. Live values and connection states stay visible as it runs.
选择输出类型后填写连接地址和信号来源。可以连接体感设备、写回 VRChat OS: Choose an output type, enter its destination and select a signal. Connect a device, write back to VRChat over OSC or record the result as a funscript.
填写 Sensa 用来接收数据的地址和端口。发送端需要将 OSC 消息发到这里。: Enter the address and port where Sensa receives data. Configure the sender to deliver OSC messages here.
通过 OSCQuery 获取参数名、类型和当前值。轮询可按设定频率刷新数据。: Use OSCQuery to read parameter names, types and current values. Polling refreshes them at the selected rate.
公布 Sensa 的接收服务，支持自动发现的发送端可以找到它。: Advertise the Sensa receiver so senders with automatic discovery can find it.
将收到的 OSC 参数继续发送到其他应用。为每个接收应用添加一个目标地址。: Forward incoming OSC parameters to other applications. Add a destination address for each application.
选择轴配置确定行程，再选择设备采用的速度或时长指令。: Choose an axis profile to set travel, then select the speed or duration commands your device uses.
请求 Avatar 持续报告 OGB / SPS 参数：每 5 秒发送 OGB_: Ask the Avatar to keep reporting OGB / SPS parameters. Sensa sends OGB_ENABLED every five seconds and clears it when OSC stops. Enable input in the top bar to drive device motion.
先安装 Intiface Engine，再由 Sensa 管理它的启动与停止。: Install Intiface Engine first, then let Sensa manage starting and stopping it.
当前列表显示冻结时的数据，便于逐项查看；OSC 接收和设备运行继续进行。: The list shows data from the moment it was frozen, ready for inspection. OSC reception and device operation continue.
映射范围决定输入两端对应的设备位置；边界范围限制最终允许到达的位置。: The mapping range sets device positions for the two ends of the input. The boundary range limits the final allowed positions.
选择按速度或时间移动，再设置过渡曲线和上限。: Choose speed-based or timed motion, then set the transition curve and limit.
测量位置到参考位置的直线距离，结果始终为零或正数。两组 XYZ 使用同一坐标系和: The straight-line distance from the measured position to the reference position, always zero or positive. Both XYZ groups use the same coordinate frame and units.
从平面参考点到测量位置，计算沿平面朝向的距离。正值在朝向一侧，负值在另一侧，落在: Measure displacement from the plane origin along its normal. Positive values lie toward the normal, negative values on the other side, and zero on the plane.
将测量位置投影到平面上，再计算投影点到平面参考点的距离。它表示沿平面偏离中心的程: Project the measured position onto the plane and measure its distance from the plane origin. This gives the offset within the plane, always zero or positive.
比较两组 XYZ 方向：同向为 0°，垂直为 90°，反向为 180°。向量长度: Compare two XYZ directions: aligned is 0°, perpendicular is 90°, and opposite is 180°. Vector lengths do not affect the angle.
测量方向相对平面的角度：沿平面为 0°，朝向法线为 +90°，背向法线为 −90: The direction relative to the plane: parallel is 0°, toward the normal is +90°, and away from it is −90°.
两条轴共同确定平面，正方向按第一条轴 × 第二条轴计算。默认 X 轴与 Y 轴得: Two axes define the plane. The positive normal is the first axis × the second axis. The default X and Y axes give +Z; swapping them reverses the depth sign.
两条轴共同确定平面，结果是测量位置在该平面内离参考点的距离。交换轴顺序保留这个距: Two axes define the plane. The result is the projected distance from the plane origin. Swapping the axes keeps this distance; the axes can follow the actual deformed directions.
分别设置 X、Y、Z 来源: Choose each X, Y, Z source
三项依次读取 {0}。: Reads the three components in order: {0}.
用 XYZ 指定垂直于平面的方向。Sensa 会将它归一化；例如 0 / 0 /: Specify the direction perpendicular to the plane as XYZ. Sensa normalizes it; for example, 0 / 0 / 1 points toward +Z.
XYZ 使用同一坐标系：X 左右、Y 高度、Z 前后。固定坐标与测量位置采用相同: Use one XYZ frame: X side-to-side, Y height and Z front-to-back. Fixed coordinates use the same units as the measured position.
选择一种空间关系，再填写测量对象或固定坐标。预设只添加计算草稿，保存后可用于映射: Choose a spatial relationship, then enter tracking objects or fixed coordinates. Presets add calculation drafts that become available to mappings and outputs after saving.
选择 Tracking Frame 的 _Origin 组。预设读取同名 _Fo: Select the Tracking Frame _Origin group. The preset reads its matching _Forward group, subtracts the positions to obtain +Z, and creates three reusable direction components.
工作平面经过 Shader 定位点，并垂直于它报告的 Forward 方向。若要: The working plane passes through the Shader position and is perpendicular to its reported Forward direction. Use a two-axis operation for a plane spanned by two actual axes.
深度正值沿平面朝向，负值在另一侧；平面内偏移表示投影点离参考点的距离。测量位置和: Positive depth follows the normal; negative depth is on the other side. Plane offset measures the projected distance from the origin. The measured and reference positions use the same frame and units.
距离沿用位置输入的单位：Contact 为米，SPS 四点与 Shader 为: Distances retain the position units: metres for Contact and Avatar-root local units for SPS four-anchor and Shader tracking. Direction vectors are normalized for the calculation.
选择自己 Avatar 内的测量位置和参考对象，一起创建深度和平面内偏移。参考对: Choose the measured position and reference object within your own avatar to create depth and in-plane offset together. The calculations follow the reference object’s current position and direction as it moves or turns.
